source: Clifford Garstang, Literary Magazine Ranking (Pushcart Prize based)
recorded: For each genre and edition year, Garstang publishes the magazine's rank, its prior-year rank and a ten-year weighted score of Pushcart Prizes and Pushcart special mentions (prizes and mentions in the last five years weigh more). He does not publish per-year prize or special-mention counts or the exact weights.
